I need to update the corresponding policy-side passage with the same clarified wording, then write out the final JSON.

edits.modify_from: a re-grasp that lifts and sets the cube back on the same target without resting elsewhere is NOT a placement either.
edits.modify_to: a grasp that lifts the cube and opens again on the very same target with no raised travel elsewhere in between is NOT a placement either. Every raised carry that ends with the cube resting within a few pixels of a stable target IS one placement, written in order, no matter what happens next: the cube being picked up again from that target later never removes the entry; the last placement is ALWAYS followed by such a re-grasp, because the demo ends by lifting the cube off its last target and carrying it to the centre, and that centre carry is the only carry you skip. Check before writing: entries = raised carries of the cube minus one, and at least the ordinal the goal names ('third' needs three entries).
